messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Tue 24 Nov
Christmas lights switch on Thu 26 at 18:00 on Passeig de Gràcia (central lanes closed all week). Barça are away in the Champions League Wed evening.

TODAY · Tue 24 Nov

1. Fira de Nadal de la Sagrada Família
🕘 Today until 21:00 (daily 10:00–21:00) · 📍 Plaça de la Sagrada Família
📊 2,377 likes on @planesenbarcelona's post
💶 Free entry
💬 Christmas market by the basilica: you wander the stalls with churros or a crêpe. A stroll with friends you already have, not a place to meet people. Steady crowd, a few hundred around at dusk; no headcount published.
https://www.instagram.com/p/DgDok80BUuK/

2. Christian Löffler - Until We Meet Again Tour
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 Teatre Coliseum
📊 41 interested on RA
💬 Seated concert of melodic, melancholic electronica from a well-known German producer in a big Gran Via theatre. Expect several hundred: the RA count is modest but it is a touring headline show in a large room.
https://ra.co/events/2489831

3. FREE GUEST LIST · Moods at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 49 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House night on the 26th floor of the W hotel with the city view, free on the guest list. Listed on four platforms; expect a busy bar-club of 150–250, dressy international crowd.
https://ra.co/events/2569428

4. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Tuesday Meetup
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 26 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,252 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Weekly founders and startup drinks, in English, your crowd for work talk. Expect 30–50: the RSVP count plus a second listing on Eventbrite, and it runs every Tuesday.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/317287981/

5. Sala Vivaldi Salsa vs Bachata, Talleres + Baile Social
🕘 Tonight 21:00 → 02:30 · 📍 Sala Vivaldi
📊 24 going on Meetup · group has 21,227 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Salsa and bachata workshops followed by social dancing until late; easy to turn up alone. Weekly night from a 21,000-member group, likely 50–80 on the floor, though the RSVP count is the only hard number.
https://www.meetup.com/free-salsa-bachata-masterclass/events/317288907/

TOMORROW · Wed 25 Nov

1. BRESH CLUB
🕘 Wed 23:00 → 06:00 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 1 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 From €15.50
💬 The Argentine party brand, so a largely Argentine and Latin crowd, with pop and reggaeton singalongs. Forecast rests on its weekly Apolo main-room residency, not RA, where the count is negligible: expect several hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2585002

2. Salmo
🕘 Wed, doors 19:30 · 📍 Razzmatazz, Sala 1
📊 Razzmatazz main room; tickets still on sale on the venue's site
💶 €34
💬 Italy's biggest rapper in Razzmatazz's main room: the largest gig of the night, likely well over a thousand and heavily Italian. Tickets were still available this afternoon.
https://www.salarazzmatazz.com/agenda

3. AI AFTER: BCN Founders & Entrepreneurs Afterwork Hangout @Secret Rooftop
🕘 Wed 19:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Club 23 Barcelona
📊 52 going on Meetup · group has 141 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Founders and AI afterwork drinks on a rooftop, in English; €5 at the door includes a drink. Expect 50–70, based on the RSVPs and a second listing on Eventbrite.
https://www.meetup.com/bcn-ai-circle-for-entrepreneurs/events/317302598/

4. VYBE l City Hall BARCELONA l BOUNCE ALL NIGHT LONG
🕘 Wed 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 City Hall
📊 170 interested on RA · also on Xceed
💶 Free guest list · paid €7–30
💬 Bouncy, bass-heavy club night in a mid-size club off Plaça Catalunya, free with guest list. Strongest RA number of the day and also on Xceed: expect a full room of a few hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2581398

5. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF, Victor Hugo & friends
🕘 Wed 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Chica Club
📊 153 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free house and electronica party from a local collective at a newer club. Solid RA interest plus an Eventbrite listing: expect a couple of hundred, local-leaning crowd.
https://ra.co/events/2552961

Scanned: Meetup 247 · RA 20 · DICE 12 · Xceed 12 · Eventbrite 132 · Luma 10 · Instagram 27 posts + 21 stories.
